lessons: Freeze verifier, fixture source, plan and status before long runs; any source change invalidates closure-bound evidence.
Use prepare then dry-run then one host worker per fixture path; preserve raw timeout/failure and never hand-edit evidence.
Bind the same Blender-published artifact to every fixture that observes dynamic asset edges; missing provenance must fail closed.
A wall deadline without host-captured exit is incomplete even when gameplay logs look healthy; remint only with a bounded longer deadline.
Transport-only MCP measurements cannot be promoted to native fixture/model-host capability.
Private diagnostic saved-room builder is not registered catalog E2E; do not toggle runtime flags to bypass that gate.

A native owner probe can prove transaction-bound Godot observation while a candidate-only profile remains non-public; keep runtime_enabled=false and public_ack=false until catalog registration and AUTH gates are independently verified.
